title: Suki Seokyeong Kang
bio: Suki Seokyeong Kang was a Korean visual artist. Kang's practice traversed painting, sculpture, performance, video, and installation. Inspired by cultural traditions of Korea as well as contemporary artistic and literary discourses. Kang decoded rules and values that govern these disciplines, turning to artistic languages of the past to construct a contextual lens through which she explored the notion of individuality and freedom in the present moment.
